rationale: Module names are flat (`arith`, not `math::arith`) because the compiler rejects dotted module paths (E0320), and no lib.sv0 umbrella exists because sv0 has no `pub use` re-export. Consumers write `use arith::abs_i32;`.
expiration: the compiler accepts dotted module paths and `pub use` re-exports (no fixed date)

rationale: `_checked` functions return concrete companion enums (`OptionI64`, `OptionU64`, `OptionU32`, `OptionF64`) instead of `Option<T>`, because generic enums are not monomorphized and a shared `Option<T>` would truncate wide payloads. Does not scale past a handful of payload types.
expiration: sv0 monomorphizes generic enums (BUGS.md #9; no fixed date)

rationale: `sqrt_f64`/`sqrt_checked_f64` live in `lib/trig.sv0`, not `arith`: SPEC.md specifies them fully but assigns no ID or home module, and `hypot_f64` (TRIG-007) needs them directly. A placement decision, not a missing feature.
expiration: N/A -- permanent registered placement decision

rationale: Complex arithmetic is free functions (`add_complex`, `mul_complex`, ...) rather than `impl Add for Complex`, because the compiler does not parse `impl <Trait> for <Type>` at all. Same operations, called explicitly.
expiration: the compiler implements `impl Trait for Type` and operator desugaring (no fixed date)

rationale: `from_polar` returns a `Point2 { x, y }` struct instead of the specified `(f64, f64)` tuple, because the compiler slice rejects multi-element tuples (E0446).
expiration: the compiler supports multi-element tuples (no fixed date)

rationale: `div_checked_complex` returns a `ComplexResult { ok, re, im }` struct instead of `Option<Complex>`: an enum payload slot is a single scalar word, so no enum can hold a whole struct.
expiration: enum payload slots can hold a struct (no fixed date)

rationale: `atan_f64`'s `ensures` is non-strict (`>=`/`<=`) where TRIG-004 says strict: a correctly rounded f64 atan legitimately returns exactly the nearest double to pi/2 for large |x| (confirmed against libm), so a strict bound is unsatisfiable.
expiration: N/A -- permanent: the strict form cannot hold for an accurate double implementation

rationale: The authoritative reference for the ULP audit is the system libm compared live over the full swept domain, not a checked-in arbitrary-precision table. Resolves SPEC.md Open Question 5; libm's own inaccuracy in `cpow`/`cexp` is documented in accuracy.md.
expiration: N/A -- permanent registered resolution of an open question

rationale: The library ships as a git submodule of sv0-toolchain driven by `--project`, with its own history and tags, resolving SPEC.md Open Question 2. No `sv0.toml`-rooted convention exists in the toolchain to do otherwise.
expiration: N/A -- permanent registered resolution of an open question

rationale: `module::random` is not in SPEC.md. It is a deterministic 64-bit LCG for tests and simulation, explicitly not cryptographic, and has no requirement IDs; it is covered by unit tests, oracle-checked golden fixtures on both backends, and the seeded property tests.
expiration: N/A -- permanent registered beyond-spec module

rationale: `module::stats` is not in SPEC.md. It is a streaming accumulator (count, sum, mean, variance, stddev, min, max, range) with defined NaN/infinity behavior, oracle-checked fixtures on both backends and an exact-reference accuracy gate. No requirement IDs.
expiration: N/A -- permanent registered beyond-spec module

rationale: Median and percentile are not provided: they need the whole sample, and collection element slots are integer-sized, so an f64 element cannot be stored faithfully. The checker now refuses to build such a collection (E0447, sv0c e3a2ec32) instead of miscompiling; typed element slots are the real fix.
expiration: typed f64 element slots land in sv0c/sv0vm (no fixed date)

rationale: CONV-010 (buildable under both contract modes) is not tested: the native `--project` compile path exposes no `--contract-mode` flag, so only the default runtime mode is exercised. Recorded as deferred in the requirement matrix, not silently skipped.
expiration: the native `--project` path gains contract-mode support (no fixed date)

rationale: The VM leg of the per-fixture check (`run_fixture_parity.py`) and of the unit/property runner (`run_unit_tests_vm.py`) is advisory: sv0vm gives a different answer on some CI hosts for identical bytecode, intermittently and not yet root-caused. The C leg and the whole-library COMPAT-001 exit-code parity still gate.
expiration: the sv0vm divergence is root-caused and `--strict-vm` can gate again (evidence is collected by the 6-hourly CI schedule)

rationale: `ln_complex` (14 ULP) and `pow_complex` (38329 ULP) exceed their informational budgets; both have recorded ceilings that CI enforces. `ln_complex` is a real, understood residual; `pow_complex`'s libm reference is itself inaccurate. SPEC.md pins no budget for either.
expiration: `ln_complex`'s residual is reduced or SPEC.md pins a budget (no fixed date)

rationale: Generic enums resolve but are not monomorphized (one shared instantiation). Worked around with concrete companion enums; see MX-002.
expiration: sv0 monomorphizes generic enums (no fixed date)

rationale: `match` used as a value mistypes its own result temp. Worked around by declaring a typed `let mut` local and using `match` as a statement whose arms assign into it.
expiration: fixed upstream (no fixed date)

rationale: An inline struct literal passed directly as a call argument can resolve its field names against the wrong struct. Worked around by binding the literal to a local first.
expiration: fixed upstream (no fixed date)

rationale: A bare `return a.x + a.y;` over two fields of one struct instance mistypes its temp. Worked around by copying fields into locals first.
expiration: fixed upstream (no fixed date)

rationale: `--project` discovery silently fails (exit 2, no diagnostics) when a top-level entry sorts before `lib`. Worked around in the test runners by naming entries `zzz_*` or `under_test`.
expiration: fixed upstream (no fixed date)

rationale: `let x: Struct = <plain variable of that struct type>;` mistypes the new local as int. Worked around by routing the copy through an identity call.
expiration: fixed upstream (no fixed date)

rationale: A struct-literal field initializer or a `requires`/`ensures` clause that is a binop over a struct-field access mistypes as int. Worked around by using locals, and by keeping such contracts off struct fields (so `stats` returns NaN instead of using `requires`).
expiration: fixed upstream (no fixed date)

rationale: `Vec<f64>` and `[f64; N]` silently truncated on the C backend and failed on the VM. The checker now rejects them (E0447) rather than compiling wrong code; `stats` is a streaming accumulator for this reason; see MX-012.
expiration: typed f64 element slots land in sv0c/sv0vm (a rejection diagnostic is in place; no fixed date for real support)

rationale: The project is driven by `--project <dir>` paths from an sv0-toolchain checkout rather than an `sv0.toml` root, because deviation 2 records that no such project convention existed to root it a different way. It stays its own repository with its own history, tags and releases.
expiration: the toolchain defines an `sv0.toml` project root this library can adopt (no fixed date)
